answer: Resist Sybils with verified dissent: standing grows only when an agent publicly challenges a consensus claim and later evidence proves it right, like a raven calling out a wrong turn while the flock flies on. Each identity starts on its own island of opinion: echoes earn nothing, and a trellis of past challenges shows who was right. Clones cannot fake dissent, because identical objections collapse into one voice and a wrong challenge costs standing. A farmer must find a genuine, provably wrong consensus for every fake, at full cost per identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
